recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆巨大的巨核細胞，核分成許多分散、深染的小葉（過度分葉 hyperlobated），細胞質豐富淡紫色，周圍背景細胞密度很高，符合 JAK2 陽性真性紅血球增多症（PV）中大型、多葉的巨核細胞。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant pale granular lilac cytoplasm and smooth border
Hyperlobated nucleus with numerous discrete, loosely connected lobes
Lobes with moderately condensed chromatin; no micromegakaryocytic or hypolobated features
Surrounding hypercellular aspirate with erythroid and myeloid precursors
Adjacent stromal/cellular fragment at the top of the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and contains a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a hyperlobated nucleus composed of many loosely connected lobes. No hypolobated or micromegakaryocytic forms are seen in this field. Background shows panmyelosis with abundant erythroid and granulocytic precursors. In a patient with a JAK2 mutation, findings are consistent with the enlarged, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes seen in polycythemia vera; trephine biopsy is needed to assess megakaryocyte clustering and fibrosis.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are also large and hyperlobated (staghorn) but occur without panmyelosis or erythroid expansion and with normal hemoglobin.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like, hypolobated nuclei and dense clustering, often with reticulin fibrosis.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal-sized with normal lobation and there is no JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation.
Megaloblastic megakaryocytes may be hyperlobated but coexist with megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.
